description:
More front end focus, required skills are: 

 
 
 CSS 3.0 

 Bootstrap 

 jQuery 

 AngularJS 

 Kendo UI 

 ASP.NET MVC 

 Top Three Skills: 
 1. UI Development (knockout, angular, bootstrap)
 2. C#/ASP.NET
 3. MVC / Entity Framework
 Job Description: 
 This position will serve as a Sr. .NET Programmer to develop and maintain Insurance applications. The candidate must also be able to work and collaborate well with others since development teams can be fluid as project needs arise. 

 Primary duties & responsibilities consist of: 

 • Position will collaborate with internal clients, managers and developers in a team environment.
 • Execute projects from initial concept through delivery.
 • Application design and development.
 • Assist in troubleshooting of final code.
 Additional Information: 
 Required: 
 • C#
 • ASP.NET MVC
 • Bootstrap
 • jQuery
 • AngularJS
 • Kendo UI
 • CSS 3.0
 Nice to have: 

 • SQL Server
 • MS Test
 • Entity Framework
 Work Environment: 
 Environment is very team oriented, and a mix of agile and waterfall methodologies.
 
 


 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 6+ MONTHS 
 
 Phone then a face to face interview 
 
 Interview Information: 
 1. Phone screen 
 
 2. Face to face with Manager
